cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus

# 检查 multi_seed 目录下的 seed=123 数据

python3 -c "
import json, glob

for name, base in [
    ('multi_seed/mistral_folio_seed123', 'results/multi_seed/mistral_folio_seed123'),
